name: Drugs
overview: Scripture warns against the deceptive and destructive nature of substances like wine and strong drink, highlighting that those who are misled by them lack wisdom (Proverbs 20:1). Believers are called to live honorably and avoid behaviors associated with drunkenness and excess, instead being filled with the Spirit (Romans 13:13; Ephesians 5:18). Sound doctrine encourages abstaining from practices that lead to uncleanness and moral failure (Galatians 5:19; Titus 2:1), emphasizing self-control and holiness in all areas including the use of drugs and alcohol.
